phases.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: complete 3×3 NPC portrait viseme atlas for a 64×64 native game portrait
Input image: Image 1 is the approved full-frame version-5 source. Preserve same woman, face, hair, framing, palette, coarse pixel structure, and exact grid.
Primary request: make fresh happy OPEN-EYE atlas. Character feels warmly friendly and genuinely cheerful.
Style/medium: crisp native-resolution pixel art, same muted game palette and existing blocky pixel scale. Every eye feature must use clean, deliberate, hard-edged pixel clusters with clear iris and pupil, tiny restrained sclera highlights, crisp eyelid line, and brows. No soft blur.
Composition/framing: exact square 3×3 atlas of complete head-and-shoulder frames; same cell boundaries and alignment; row-major A B C / D E F / G H X.
Lighting/mood: gently lifted cheeks and friendly open eyes. Natural restrained smile, visible warm mouth corners, subtle cheek lift.
Constraints: retain all nine distinct speech poses in order and their practical openings: A closed M/B/P; B narrow consonant with tiny teeth; C medium EH; D moderately open AH; E rounded OH; F small OO/W; G upper teeth touching lower lip F/V; H slight tongue behind teeth for L; X relaxed closed mouth. Preserve modest natural mouth size. Smile changes mouth-corner tension and cheeks, not viseme category or opening. Keep brows calm and eyes bright, no dramatic angle.
Avoid: blur, airbrushed or smoky eye shadows over iris, soft painted shading, smudged lines, high-resolution smooth painting, giant grin, large tooth blocks, manic expression, oversized mouth, caricature, changed identity or hair, framing changes, objects, text, grid lines, borders, missing cells.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: complete square 3×3 blink atlas for a 64×64 native NPC game portrait
Input image: Image 1 is the finished happy open-eye revision-2 atlas.
Primary request: create HALF-BLINK atlas.
Style/medium: preserve exact crisp, hard-edged pixel-art clusters and muted original palette. Keep eyes sharp.
Composition/framing: same complete portraits, exact 3×3 grid, square canvas and cell alignment; A B C / D E F / G H X.
Constraints: Change only upper eyelids in every cell. Upper lid covers about half each iris. Preserve cheerful brows, lifted cheeks, face, hair, colors, and each exact corresponding speech-mouth shape and opening. Preserve crisp visible pupil/iris detail. Full sheets only.
Avoid: blur, airbrushed shadows, changed eyes beyond lids, mouth edits, expression change, cropped frames, overlays, missing cells, labels, borders, grid separators, new objects.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: complete square 3×3 blink atlas for a 64×64 native NPC game portrait
Input image: Image 1 is the finished happy open-eye revision-2 atlas.
Primary request: create CLOSED-BLINK atlas.
Style/medium: preserve exact crisp, hard-edged pixel-art clusters and muted original palette. Keep eyes sharp.
Composition/framing: same complete portraits, exact 3×3 grid, square canvas and cell alignment; A B C / D E F / G H X.
Constraints: Change only eyelids in every cell. Both eyes fully shut with no iris or sclera visible. Preserve cheerful brows, lifted cheeks, face, hair, colors, and each exact corresponding speech-mouth shape and opening. Preserve all complete portrait frames.

visible_deviations: At sheet scale, C/D/G show visible teeth but remain moderate. Dark pixel eye shadow remains close to source style; iris/pupil and eyelid clusters read crisply.
